findings.containment: The form remains a noun in the supplied grammar and does not replace the ordinary destination or group reading.

epistemic.reason: The packet explicitly identifies the verbal-noun form; its state-process effect is interpretive.

findings.title: Driving, destination, arrival-state

findings.containment: The ordinary drive to the named Hell remains intact; water and herd imagery are contained local resonances, not literal geography or voluntary travel.

epistemic.reason: The clause relations are grounded; their integrated water-arrival image is a local semantic inference.
